title: Sparkly wristwatch
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <!-- sparkles -->
  <g fill='#FFE94A'>
    <path d='M14 22 L16 28 L22 30 L16 32 L14 38 L12 32 L6 30 L12 28 Z'/>
    <path d='M82 18 L83.5 22 L87.5 23.5 L83.5 25 L82 29 L80.5 25 L76.5 23.5 L80.5 22 Z'/>
    <path d='M86 66 L87.5 70 L91.5 71.5 L87.5 73 L86 77 L84.5 73 L80.5 71.5 L84.5 70 Z'/>
    <path d='M16 72 L17 75.5 L20.5 76.5 L17 77.5 L16 81 L15 77.5 L11.5 76.5 L15 75.5 Z'/>
  </g>
  <!-- small sparkle dots -->
  <g fill='#FFF7B0'>
    <circle cx='28' cy='14' r='1.6'/>
    <circle cx='74' cy='10' r='1.4'/>
    <circle cx='90' cy='46' r='1.5'/>
    <circle cx='92' cy='54' r='1.2'/>
    <circle cx='10' cy='50' r='1.5'/>
    <circle cx='22' cy='86' r='1.4'/>
    <circle cx='78' cy='88' r='1.6'/>
  </g>

  <!-- top strap -->
  <rect x='41' y='14' width='18' height='18' rx='5' fill='#8B4A2B'/>
  <rect x='45' y='16' width='10' height='2' rx='1' fill='#B86A3E'/>

  <!-- bottom strap -->
  <rect x='41' y='68' width='18' height='18' rx='5' fill='#8B4A2B'/>
  <rect x='45' y='82' width='10' height='2' rx='1' fill='#B86A3E'/>

  <!-- watch body -->
  <circle cx='50' cy='50' r='22' fill='#E8C547'/>
  <circle cx='50' cy='50' r='19' fill='#C79A28'/>
  <circle cx='50' cy='50' r='17' fill='#F7F1D0'/>

  <!-- hour markers -->
  <g fill='#2F5D8A'>
    <rect x='49' y='35' width='2' height='4' rx='1'/>
    <rect x='49' y='61' width='2' height='4' rx='1'/>
    <rect x='35' y='49' width='4' height='2' rx='1'/>
    <rect x='61' y='49' width='4' height='2' rx='1'/>
  </g>

  <!-- hour hand -->
  <rect x='52' y='43' width='3' height='10' rx='1.5' fill='#E85D75' transform='rotate(30 50 50)'/>

  <!-- minute hand -->
  <rect x='52' y='37' width='2.5' height='15' rx='1.2' fill='#4A8FE7' transform='rotate(-50 50 50)'/>

  <!-- center pin -->
  <circle cx='50' cy='50' r='2.2' fill='#7C5CBF'/>

  <!-- crown -->
  <rect x='71' y='47' width='5' height='6' rx='1.5' fill='#D4A930'/>
</svg>
